stories.title: US Marshals arrest 3rd suspect accused of killing 10-year-old Cleveland boy Kaden Coleman
stories.summary: Khalif Muhammed, 34, was arrested early Tuesday morning in McMechen, West Virginia, by members of the U.S. Marshals Northern Ohio Violent Fugitive Task Force.

stories.title: Cleveland City Council votes to boycott Starbucks in protest of company's labor practices
stories.summary: Cleveland City Council calls for a Starbucks boycott, criticizing its labor practices amid the company's failure to negotiate contracts with its unionized workers.

stories.title: Former Morton Salt workers sue over alleged labor law violations after Lake County mine flood
stories.summary: Three former Morton Salt mine workers are suing the company, claiming it ignored warnings about flood risks and failed to provide required notice before layoffs.

stories.title: Breaking the cycle: Northeast Ohio father confronts childhood trauma to build a better future for his children
stories.summary: After battling addiction and spending time in prison, Patrick Vorreiter found hope through The City Mission's Crossroads program.

stories.title: Federal funding cuts force closure of 5 Boys & Girls Clubs in Northeast Ohio
stories.summary: The Boys & Girls Clubs of Northeast Ohio will close five locations due to federal funding cuts of about $2 million, impacting after-school care for many children.

stories.title: Solon cracks down on feeding wildlife after complaints from residents
stories.summary: The city has passed a new ordinance restricting the feeding of wildlife amid complaints about property damage and safety concerns.

stories.title: Ohio Gov.-elect Amy Acton holds first public event since Election Day
stories.summary: Gov.-elect Amy Acton said she is focused on a smooth transition into office, building her team, and fulfilling her campaign promises.

stories.title: Cleveland man gets 27-year sentence for 2025 murder in Akron
stories.summary: Timothy Whittorne, 34, was sentenced for the murder of Razeil Robinson near the Rosemary Square apartments in September 2025.

stories.title: The Tradition Continues: Tickets to Trans-Siberian Orchestra
stories.summary: Enter to Win Tickets to Ghosts of Christmas Eve 2026!

stories.title: Cleveland Browns' Week 12 matchup vs. Las Vegas Raiders flexed to 'Sunday Night Football' slot
stories.summary: The Cleveland Browns' Week 12 matchup with the Las Vegas Raiders, originally set for 1 p.m., will now kick off at 8:20 p.m. on Nov. 29. The game will air on WKYC.

stories.title: 2 security guards indicted in assault of 36-year-old man at Lucky's Bar & Grill in Cleveland
stories.summary: Michael Ramos, 37, and Alex Maldonado, 27, were indicted Tuesday, Nov. 17, according to the Cuyahoga County Prosecutor's Office.

stories.title: 21-year-old man arrested following deadly crash involving RTA van in Cleveland
stories.summary: A 21-year-old man was arrested in connection with a deadly Cleveland crash that killed a 73-year-old RTA van passenger.
